title: Persistent workers must not be used as closeout one-shot commands
summary: refresh-worker script sleeps for days; closeout gates must use bounded one-shot refresh commands that exit with evidence.
retrievalQuestions: Why did refresh-worker hang during All Systems Go closeout?
What command pattern should replace sleeping workers in gates?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Closeout invokes worker, poller, daemon, or long sleep
runPreflight: Read script header for daemon vs one-shot lifecycle
doNot: Wait for persistent worker inside closeout run
Treat timeout as functional failure without checking sleep
